question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?

prediction.sql:
WITH top_industry AS (
    SELECT industry
    FROM companies_industries
    GROUP BY industry
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cd.year_founded,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.company_id) AS new_unicorns
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    JOIN companies_funding cf ON cd.company_id = cf.company_id
    WHERE ci.industry = (SELECT industry FROM top_industry)
      AND cd.year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
      AND cf.valuation >= 1000000000
    GROUP BY cd.year_founded
)
SELECT AVG(new_unicorns * 1.0) AS average_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM yearly_counts;

FROM (
  SELECT d.year_founded, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM companies_dates d
  JOIN companies_industries i ON d.company_id = i.company_id
  WHERE i.industry = (
    SELECT industry FROM companies_industries GROUP BY industry ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
  )
  AND d.year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
  GROUP BY d.year_founded
)
